purpose: Canada's toll facilities, assembled one by one because no register of them exists. Each fact carries the document it was read from. A fare is recorded only with the date it took effect, or the date since which the publisher says it has not changed.

from.match: 407 Etr & Autoroute Qew & Queen Elizabeth Way & Route 407, City Of Burlington, Ontario

to.match: 407 Etr & Autoroute 407 & Brock Road & Highway 407 & Route 1, City Of Pickering, Ontario

facts.en: Leased for 99 years from 6 April 1999 under the Highway 407 Concession and Ground Lease Agreement, which obliges the concessionaire to finance, operate, maintain and toll the highway.
facts.zh: 依据《407 号公路特许经营与土地租赁协议》，自 1999 年 4 月 6 日起租期 99 年，特许经营方负责融资、运营、养护并收费。
facts.source: Information and Privacy Commissioner of Ontario, Order PO-1976

facts.en: Tolls and fees are set by the concessionaire, not the province. Tolling is all-electronic, with no booths.
facts.zh: 通行费与各项收费由特许经营方而非省政府制定。全电子收费，不设收费亭。
facts.source: 407 ETR, Toll Rates; 407 ETR, Frequently Asked Questions

facts.en: Ends at Brock Road in Pickering. Highway 407 east of there is owned by the province and is not part of the concession.
facts.zh: 东端止于皮克林的 Brock Road，以东的 407 号公路属省有，不在特许范围内。

from.match: Route 1, Borden-Carleton, Prince Edward Island (the westernmost of the Route 1 segments returned, where the road leaves the town for the bridge)

to.match: Autoroute 16 & Confederation Bridge & Route 16 Highway & Route Transcanadienne & Trans-Canada Highway, Bayfield, New Brunswick

lengthKm.source: Transport Canada, briefing binder: Confederation Bridge Tolls (May 2025)

operator.en: Strait Crossing Bridge Limited, for the federal government, which owns the bridge
operator.zh: Strait Crossing Bridge Limited 代联邦政府运营，大桥归联邦所有

facts.en: Strait Crossing Development Inc. signed agreements with Canada in 1993 to design, build, finance, operate and maintain the bridge, at a cost of approximately $1 billion.
facts.zh: 1993 年，Strait Crossing Development Inc. 与加拿大政府签约，负责大桥的设计、建造、融资、运营和养护，造价约 10 亿加元。
facts.source: Transport Canada, briefing binder: Confederation Bridge Tolls (May 2025)

facts.en: Under the Bridge Operating Agreement the operator may raise tolls each year by 75% of the Consumer Price Index, and recover any shortfall below a guaranteed revenue floor.
facts.zh: 依据《大桥运营协议》，运营方每年可按消费者物价指数的 75% 上调通行费，并可补回低于保底收入的差额。
facts.source: Transport Canada, briefing binder: Confederation Bridge Tolls (May 2025)

note.en: Held at the 2022 rate through 2025 by federal payments in return for the operator waiving its increases.
note.zh: 联邦政府付款换取运营方放弃涨价，2023 至 2025 年维持 2022 年费率。

fares.source: Transport Canada, briefing binder: Confederation Bridge Tolls (May 2025)
Parliamentary Budget Officer, Reducing tolls on the Confederation Bridge (9 December 2025)

name.zh: 科比奎德山口收费公路（Cobequid Pass）

to.match: Route Transcanadienne, Thomson Station, Nova Scotia

lengthKm.source: Highway 104 Western Alignment Corporation, Annual Report 2023-24

operator.en: Highway 104 Western Alignment Corporation, owned by the Province of Nova Scotia
operator.zh: Highway 104 Western Alignment Corporation，新斯科舍省全资

opened.source: Highway 104 Western Alignment Corporation, Annual Report 2023-24

facts.en: Tolled under the Highway 104 Western Alignment Regulations (N.S. Reg. 91/1996, amended to N.S. Reg. 49/2025). Vehicles registered in Nova Scotia have been exempt since 16 December 2021.
facts.zh: 依据《104 号公路西线法规》（N.S. Reg. 91/1996，修订至 N.S. Reg. 49/2025）收费。自 2021 年 12 月 16 日起，新斯科舍省登记车辆免费。

facts.en: Since 6 March 2025, trucks with commercial plates registered in a US state pay twice the toll of other trucks.
facts.zh: 自 2025 年 3 月 6 日起，美国各州登记的商用牌照货车按其他货车两倍收费。
facts.source: Highway 104 Western Alignment Regulations, s. 4, added by N.S. Reg. 49/2025

note.en: Cash fare for a passenger car. The operator states passenger tolls have not risen since 2004.
note.zh: 小客车现金费率。运营方称客车通行费自 2004 年起未上调。

fares.source: Cobequid Pass, Tolls & Fees; Cobequid Pass, FAQ

operator.en: Federal Bridge Corporation Limited owns, manages and operates the Canadian portion; the Michigan Department of Transportation the US portion
operator.zh: 加方部分由联邦桥梁公司（FBCL）拥有、管理和运营，美方部分属密歇根州交通厅

facts.en: Cash has not been accepted since 1 April 2025.
facts.zh: 自 2025 年 4 月 1 日起不再收现金。

fareNote.en: The operator publishes its current rates without the date they took effect, so none is shown.
fareNote.zh: 运营方公布的现行费率未注明生效日期，故不列出。

operator.en: The International Bridge Administration of the Michigan Department of Transportation, overseen by the joint Sault Ste. Marie Bridge Authority; Federal Bridge Corporation Limited owns the Canadian interest
operator.zh: 由密歇根州交通厅下属的国际桥梁管理处运营，美加联合的苏圣玛丽桥梁管理局监督；联邦桥梁公司（FBCL）拥有加方权益

opened.source: Michigan Department of Transportation, Toll rollback coming to International Bridge Oct. 31 (14 September 2026)

note.en: Car, light truck or motorcycle; US$4.70.
note.zh: 小汽车、轻型货车或摩托车；美元价 4.70。

fares.source: Sault Ste. Marie International Bridge, Toll Rates (Auto)

operator.en: The Thousand Islands Bridge Authority, a New York State entity, under a bi-national agreement; Federal Bridge Corporation Limited owns the Canadian interest
operator.zh: 由纽约州的千岛桥梁管理局依两国协议运营；联邦桥梁公司（FBCL）拥有加方权益

note.zh: 小汽车、皮卡或摩托车；美元价 4.00。

fares.source: Thousand Islands Bridge Authority, Toll Rates

operator.en: The Seaway International Bridge Corporation, a joint venture of Federal Bridge Corporation Limited and the US Great Lakes St. Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation
operator.zh: 海道国际大桥公司运营，为联邦桥梁公司（FBCL）与美国大湖—圣劳伦斯海道开发公司的合营

note.zh: 4,080 公斤以下两轴车；美元价 3.75。

fares.source: Seaway International Bridge Corporation, toll rate adjustment (20 January 2025)

fbcl.en: Federal Bridge Corporation Limited holds the Canadian federal interest in four of the international bridges between Ontario and the United States.
fbcl.zh: 联邦桥梁公司（FBCL）持有安大略与美国之间四座国际桥的加拿大联邦权益。
fbcl.source: Federal Bridge Corporation Limited, Portfolio of Assets
